name: promptgen
description: Turn rough instructions into optimized, evidence-based prompts for AI agents, coding agents, tools, eval graders, and subagent briefings. Built on Anthropic / OpenAI guidance through April 2026 and the 2025-2026 academic literature. Copies to the clipboard on macOS, Linux and Windows.

interface.shortDescription: Turn rough asks into strong prompts
interface.longDescription: Turns a rough description into a structured prompt for Claude, GPT, Codex or a generic model, with an outcome contract, done-when criteria, security hardening when needed, and an anti-pattern self-check, then copies it to the clipboard.
defaultPrompt: Use $promptgen to turn this rough instruction into a stronger prompt.
Use $promptgen to write a Codex coding-agent prompt for this task.
Use $promptgen to draft an eval grader prompt with calibration anchors.
